data.title: CODE Voting System
data.statement:
In the Congregation Of Democratic Exoplanets (or CODE for short), there is a voting system to elect a chancellor and to make sure there is no fraud. Each planet elects ten representatives to represent the planet wanting each candidate. 
For example, if the planet of Moosetopia has 55% of its population wanting Leader A, 35% wanting Leader B, and 10% wanting Leader C, then five representatives will vote for Leader A, three representatives will vote for Leader B, and one representative will vote for Leader C (with the the leftover representatives voting Revote). After all the votes are tallied up, the candidate with the majority wins! If there isn't a majority or the majority of representatives voted {{Revote}}, then the voting process restarts.
Your job is to create a system that will determine the chancellor after the votes are cast.

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

In the Congregation Of Democratic Exoplanets (or CODE for short), there is a voting system to elect a chancellor and to make sure there is no fraud. Each planet elects ten representatives to represent the planet wanting each candidate.
For example, if the planet of Moosetopia has 55% of its population wanting Leader A, 35% wanting Leader B, and 10% wanting Leader C, then five representatives will vote for Leader A, three representatives will vote for Leader B, and one representative will vote for Leader C (with the the leftover representatives voting Revote). After all the votes are tallied up, the candidate with the majority wins! If there isn't a majority or the majority of representatives voted Revote, then the voting process restarts.
Your job is to create a system that will determine the chancellor after the votes are cast.
Input
Line 1: Two integers: n and c, representing the number of planets and the number of candidates available to vote for.
Line 2: c space-separated strings, representing the names of the candidates available to vote for.
n lines: c space-separated integers that represent the percent of the population of that planet that votes for the candidate at that index.
Output
The name representing the new chancellor, or Revote if no chancellor was decided on.
Constraints
c>1
Example
Input
1 3
Moose John Bob
55 35 10
Output
Moose
